import Foundation

actor Tracker {
  var active = 0
  var peak = 0
  var completed = 0
  func work(_ item: Int) async {
    active += 1
    peak = max(peak, active)
    try? await Task.sleep(for: .milliseconds(40))
    active -= 1
    completed += 1
  }
  func snapshot() -> (Int, Int) { (peak, completed) }
}

final class Launcher {
  let tracker: Tracker
  init(tracker: Tracker) { self.tracker = tracker }

  func captureList(_ items: [Int]) -> [Task<Void, Never>] {
    var tasks: [Task<Void, Never>] = []
    for item in items {
      tasks.append(
        Task(priority: .utility) { [weak self] in
          await self?.tracker.work(item)
        })
    }
    return tasks
  }
}

func letBinding(_ items: [Int], tracker: Tracker) -> [Task<Void, Never>] {
  var tasks: [Task<Void, Never>] = []
  for item in items {
    let task = Task(priority: .utility) {
      await tracker.work(item)
    }
    tasks.append(task)
  }
  return tasks
}

func explicitType(_ items: [Int], tracker: Tracker) -> [Task<Void, Never>] {
  var tasks: [Task<Void, Never>] = []
  for item in items {
    tasks.append(
      Task<Void, Never>(priority: .utility) {
        await tracker.work(item)
      })
  }
  return tasks
}

func drain(_ tasks: [Task<Void, Never>]) async {
  await withTaskGroup(of: Void.self) { group in
    for task in tasks {
      group.addTask { await task.value }
    }
  }
}

for (name, make) in [
  ("captureList", { (t: Tracker) in Launcher(tracker: t).captureList([1, 2, 3, 4]) }),
  ("letBinding", { (t: Tracker) in letBinding([1, 2, 3, 4], tracker: t) }),
  ("explicitType", { (t: Tracker) in explicitType([1, 2, 3, 4], tracker: t) }),
] as [(String, (Tracker) -> [Task<Void, Never>])] {
  let tracker = Tracker()
  let launcher = Launcher(tracker: tracker)
  let tasks = name == "captureList" ? launcher.captureList([1, 2, 3, 4]) : make(tracker)
  await drain(tasks)
  let (peak, completed) = await tracker.snapshot()
  precondition(peak == 4 && completed == 4, "\(name) peak=\(peak) completed=\(completed)")
  print("\(name) peak=\(peak), completed=\(completed)")
}
